profile_text.body:
The Technology Innovation Institute describes itself as a leading global scientific research center and the applied research pillar of Abu Dhabi's Advanced Technology Research Council. It is a non-profit government laboratory founded in 2020. Its Falcon LLM site presents the Falcon family as generative large language models intended to make advanced AI accessible and available to everyone, everywhere.

The Falcon line includes Falcon-H1, Falcon-E, Falcon Perception, Falcon Arabic, Falcon H1R 7B, Falcon Mamba 7B, Falcon 2 11B, Falcon 180B, Falcon 40B, and Falcon 10B. The site states that Falcon-H1 outperforms Meta's LLaMA and Alibaba's Qwen, that Falcon 2 11B outperforms Meta's Llama 3 8B and performs on par with Google Gemma 7B as independently verified by the Hugging Face Leaderboard, and that Falcon 180B has 180 billion parameters trained on 3.5 trillion tokens. It also describes Falcon Mamba 7B as the first open source released State Space Language Model, and Falcon 40B as the first home-grown open source large language model released with weights for research and commercial use. The institute has launched the non-profit Falcon Foundation to champion open-sourcing of generative AI models, and AI71, launched by the Advanced Technology Research Council and VentureOne, has run calls for proposals using Falcon 10B.

Falcon is a UAE-hosted open-source LLM under Apache 2.0, positioned for sovereign AI with Middle East data residency. No litigation, MCP server, SEC filing, or patent facts are associated with the organization.
